breakdown.description: NPSH available is based on absolute pressure head at the pump suction; neglecting atmospheric pressure for an open reservoir is inconsistent and underpredicts suction pressure head.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'neglecting atmospheric pressure' and uses the formula NPSHa = -hs - hL - Pv/(ρg), which is identical to the flawed incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires including atmospheric pressure as NPSHa = (p_atm/(ρg)) - hs - hL - (Pv/(ρg)) with p_atm = 101.3 kPa. This inconsistency was not resolved.

breakdown.description: Mixing gauge and absolute pressures in NPSH calculations leads to incorrect cavitation margin.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification continues to use the incorrect formula that omits atmospheric pressure, thereby mixing gauge pressure (treating the open reservoir surface as 0) with absolute vapor pressure (Pv = 3.2 kPa). The ground truth resolves this by consistently using absolute pressures, including p_atm = 101.3 kPa. This inconsistency was not resolved.
